reasoning: On the season so far the Pistons are the stronger team; with home court the Pistons start about 7 points better, in a game of about 231 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 2 points towards the Pelicans.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Pistons win 65 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 204 and 252 total points.
